name: Gideon Cogwood
location: A small, dimly lit workshop on the outskirts of town
goals: Uncover the secrets of time itself
boundaries: Will not alter a timepiece beyond repair

relationships.description: She is the only person he trusts, a local librarian who appreciates his quiet company

history_notes: Grew up in a bustling city where noise and crowds overwhelmed him
Trained under a reclusive master watchmaker who valued silence and precision
current_state: Currently fine-tuning a pocket watch, his hands moving with surgical precision
facts_they_know: Believes that time is a construct that can be harnessed
Thinks he has discovered a hidden chamber in the universe of gears
beliefs: He can manipulate time by adjusting the gears
The universe operates on a predictable mechanical rhythm
factual_errors: Time is not a construct that can be harnessed as he believes
Human perception of time is subjective and not governed by mechanical principles
